mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity and stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market with deteriorating employment conditions, which reduces consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals a deepening contraction in household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 3% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals a strong acceleration in manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 1% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).
